statement: The project began by asking how to build n8n-like automation from logic and free tools already available to ordinary computer users.
A permanent automation platform can become a runtime dependency and lock-in point.
Repeated LLM inference creates recurring cost when deterministic work is sent to AI again and again.
A personal computer already exposes files shell Python browser scheduler CPU/GPU local network and potentially local AI.
GitHub can provide distribution versioning Actions releases collaboration and community without being the mandatory runtime.
Sheets and Apps Script can provide lightweight state UI triggers and integrations.
AI may be most useful for intent interpretation planning repair and semantic exceptions rather than routine execution.
Generated automation may be able to keep running after our own tool is closed or removed.
Colab can reduce experimentation friction but should not be assumed to be durable production infrastructure.
A planner may choose among local tools GitHub Google local AI and cloud AI according to capability cost privacy and reliability.
Successful AI-assisted behavior could later be crystallized into deterministic recipes.
Preserving how hypotheses evolved is important because freezing the latest idea too early narrows the search space.
